why: Also unblocked by the schematic. The $2018+ voice-status lines are the last unexplained hardware feedback path, and CALIBRATE (autotune-selftest.md) depends on what they mean. The DCO-timer half is largely settled by the CEM3396 datasheet, so this is mostly the $2018+ read.

Gates testing any modified firmware on hardware without reburning EPROMs. The blocker is an external reply (One ROM access time), so ask now even though it is not code: the lead time runs in parallel with 1 and 2.

Code-only confirmations. Doing it after #35 means the provisional io-map bits can be checked from both the code and the schematic in one pass, and it settles poly aftertouch, a user-visible behaviour.

v1.20 is the best prior art for the MIDI-under-load limitation, the main reason anyone would rewrite this firmware. Ranked after the open hardware questions because it builds on the docs those finish, not the other way round.
Self-contained bulk work that closes the patch-ROM track. It unblocks nothing else, so it goes last.
